verdict.rationale: Codex explicitly runs tasks in isolated cloud sandboxes with per-repo configurable setup, and the CLI exposes sandbox/permission controls (writable roots) plus git checkpoints to revert changes, which together let a user test agent actions without touching real/production files. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of production-vs-test data separation guarantees, and independent hands-on verification that the sandbox reliably prevents access to production systems (one community report even questions file-system access safety).
